(function(){
'use strict';
const clean=(x,n=20000)=>typeof x==='string'?x.slice(0,n):'';
const copy=x=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));
const now=()=>new Date().toISOString();
const uuid=()=>globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.()||'g'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10);
const organisations=['CPAM','ARS','SESAN','CPTS','MSP','CDS','Autre'];
const globalFields=['messages','consensus','desaccords','edl','irritants','questions','actions','suivi'];
function cleanRoster(rows){const ids=new Set();return (Array.isArray(rows)?rows:[]).slice(0,10).filter(x=>x&&typeof x==='object').map(x=>{let id=/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(x.id||'')?x.id:uuid();if(ids.has(id))id=uuid();ids.add(id);return {id,name:clean(x.name,100),organisation:clean(x.organisation,80),department:clean(x.department,80),role:clean(x.role,80),level:clean(x.level,80),experience:clean(x.experience,80)};});}
function newWorkshop(){return {id:uuid(),title:'Journée exercice coordonné et numérique',date:'',animatorEmail:'',instructions:''};}
function cleanWorkshop(x){const w=newWorkshop();for(const k of Object.keys(w))if(typeof x?.[k]==='string')w[k]=clean(x[k],k==='instructions'?3000:250)||w[k];return w;}
function cleanGlobal(x){return Object.fromEntries(globalFields.map(k=>[k,clean(x?.[k])]));}
function enrichSession(s,x={}){
 s.groupKey=clean(x.groupKey||x.importedFrom||x.id,100)||s.id;
 s.roster=cleanRoster(x.roster);s.registrationCompleted=x.registrationCompleted===true;
 s.workshop=x.workshop?cleanWorkshop(x.workshop):Object.keys(x).length?{id:'legacy',title:'Journée exercice coordonné et numérique',date:'',animatorEmail:'',instructions:''}:newWorkshop();
 s.assignedJourney=CATALOG.journeys.some(j=>j.id===x.assignedJourney)?x.assignedJourney:s.currentJourney;
 s.registrationDraft=x.registrationDraft&&typeof x.registrationDraft==='object'?{name:clean(x.registrationDraft.name,180),department:clean(x.registrationDraft.department,180),animatorEmail:clean(x.registrationDraft.animatorEmail,250),assignedJourney:clean(x.registrationDraft.assignedJourney,80),roster:cleanRoster(x.registrationDraft.roster)}:null;
 s.demo=x.demo===true;s.receivedAt=clean(x.receivedAt,60);s.receivedFile=clean(x.receivedFile,250);
 return s;
}
function hasWork(s,jid){const js=s.journeys?.[jid];return !!js&&(Object.values(js.summary||{}).some(v=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim())||Object.values(js.steps||{}).some(st=>['actors','tools','irritants'].some(k=>st[k]?.length)||Object.values(st.discussion||{}).some(v=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim())));}
function visibleGroups(sessions){return sessions.filter(s=>s.registrationCompleted||s.roster?.some(p=>p.name.trim())||CATALOG.journeys.some(j=>hasWork(s,j.id)));}
function units(sessions){return sessions.flatMap(s=>CATALOG.journeys.filter(j=>j.id===s.assignedJourney||hasWork(s,j.id)).map(j=>({s,j,js:s.journeys?.[j.id]||{steps:{},summary:{}}})));}
function contributions(sessions){
 const out=[];
 for(const {s,j,js} of units(sessions)){
  const origin={group:s.name,groupKey:s.groupKey||s.id,department:s.department,journey:j.title,jid:j.id};
  for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(js.summary||{}))if(typeof value==='string'&&value.trim())out.push({...origin,step:'',card:'Synthèse du groupe',kind:'summary',field:key,text:value});
  for(const step of j.steps){const st=js.steps?.[String(step.number)];if(!st)continue;
   for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(st.discussion||{}))if(typeof value==='string'&&value.trim())out.push({...origin,step:step.number,card:'Échanges de l’étape',kind:'discussion',field:key,text:value});
   for(const kind of ['actors','tools','irritants'])for(const entry of st[kind]||[]){
    const label=globalThis.ExcoCore.entryLabel(kind,entry);
    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(entry.notes||{}))if(typeof value==='string'&&value.trim())out.push({...origin,step:step.number,card:label,kind,field:key,text:value,entryId:entry.id});
    if(kind==='irritants')out.push({...origin,step:step.number,card:label,kind,field:'irritant-card',text:label,entryId:entry.id});
   }
  }
 }
 return out;
}
function ratingRows(sessions){
 const out=[];
 for(const {s,j,js} of units(sessions))for(const step of j.steps)for(const e of js.steps?.[String(step.number)]?.tools||[])out.push({group:s.name,groupKey:s.groupKey||s.id,journey:j.title,jid:j.id,step:step.number,tool:globalThis.ExcoCore.entryLabel('tools',e),cardId:e.cardId,...Object.fromEntries(['pertinence','facilite','temps','equipement'].map(k=>[k,Number.isInteger(e.ratings?.[k])&&e.ratings[k]>=1&&e.ratings[k]<=5?e.ratings[k]:null]))});
 return out;
}
function aggregateRatings(sessions){
 const by=new Map();for(const row of ratingRows(sessions)){const key=row.cardId==='joker'?'joker:'+row.tool:row.cardId;if(!by.has(key))by.set(key,{id:key,name:row.tool,occurrences:0,groups:new Set(),criteria:{}});const a=by.get(key);a.occurrences++;a.groups.add(row.groupKey);
  for(const k of ['pertinence','facilite','temps','equipement'])if(row[k]!==null){if(!a.criteria[k])a.criteria[k]=new Map();const m=a.criteria[k];if(!m.has(row.groupKey))m.set(row.groupKey,[]);m.get(row.groupKey).push(row[k]);}
 }
 return [...by.values()].map(a=>({id:a.id,name:a.name,occurrences:a.occurrences,groups:a.groups.size,criteria:Object.fromEntries(['pertinence','facilite','temps','equipement'].map(k=>{const groupMeans=[...(a.criteria[k]||new Map()).values()].map(v=>v.reduce((n,x)=>n+x,0)/v.length);return [k,{value:groupMeans.length?groupMeans.reduce((n,x)=>n+x,0)/groupMeans.length:null,n:groupMeans.length}]}))})).sort((a,b)=>b.groups-a.groups||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'fr'));
}
function progress(s){const core=globalThis.ExcoCore;return units([s]).map(({j})=>({journey:j.title,jid:j.id,...core.stats(s,j.id)}));}
function fingerprint(s){const x=globalThis.ExcoCore.cleanSession(s);for(const k of ['id','receivedAt','receivedFile','importedFrom','registrationDraft'])delete x[k];const sort=v=>Array.isArray(v)?v.map(sort):v&&typeof v==='object'?Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(v).filter(k=>k!=='id').sort().map(k=>[k,sort(v[k])])):v;return JSON.stringify(sort(x));}
function validatePayload(json){
 if(!json||json.format!=='exco-num-v5'||!Array.isArray(json.sessions)||!json.sessions.length||json.sessions.length>100)throw Error('Ce fichier ne contient pas une sauvegarde du jeu (1 à 100 groupes).');
 for(const s of json.sessions)if(Array.isArray(s?.roster)&&s.roster.length>10)throw Error('Le groupe « '+clean(s.name,180)+' » dépasse dix participants. Répartissez-les sur plusieurs tables avant l’import.');
 return json.sessions.map(x=>globalThis.ExcoCore.cleanSession(x));
}
function classifyImport(existing,incoming){
 const map=new Map(existing.map(s=>[s.groupKey||s.id,s]));
 return incoming.map(s=>{const previous=map.get(s.groupKey||s.id);let status=previous?(fingerprint(previous)===fingerprint(s)?'identical':'conflict'):'new';const result={session:s,previous,status};if(!previous)map.set(s.groupKey||s.id,s);return result;});
}
function applyImport(existing,candidates,decisions={}){
 const result=copy(existing),log=[];let added=0,replaced=0,skipped=0;
 for(let i=0;i<candidates.length;i++){
  const c=candidates[i],s=copy(c.session),key=s.groupKey||s.id,at=result.findIndex(x=>(x.groupKey||x.id)===key);
  const action=decisions[i]||(c.status==='new'?'add':'skip');
  if(c.status==='identical'||action==='skip'){skipped++;log.push({group:s.name,status:'ignoré',at:now()});continue;}
  if(at>=0&&action==='replace'){s.id=result[at].id;s.receivedAt=now();result[at]=s;replaced++;}
  else if(at>=0&&action==='copy'){s.id=uuid();s.groupKey=uuid();s.name+=' (copie)';s.receivedAt=now();result.push(s);added++;}
  else if(at<0&&action==='add'){s.receivedAt=now();if(result.some(x=>x.id===s.id))s.id=uuid();result.push(s);added++;}
  else {skipped++;continue;}
  log.push({group:s.name,status:action,at:now(),file:s.receivedFile||''});
 }
 return {sessions:result,added,replaced,skipped,log};
}
function toolTip(card){const base=card?.description||card?.subtitle||'';const parent=card?.parent||({chat:'santelien',maillage:'ror'}[card?.id])||card?.id;const kit=CATALOG.kit[parent];return base+(kit?.Statut?' Statut du kit : '+kit.Statut:'');}
function rosterWarnings(s){const n=s.roster.filter(p=>p.name.trim()).length,msg=[];if(n<5||n>7)msg.push(n+' participant'+(n>1?'s':'')+' : cible conseillée de 5 à 7, maximum 10.');const orgs=new Set(s.roster.map(p=>p.organisation));const missing=['CPAM','ARS','SESAN'].filter(x=>!orgs.has(x));if(missing.length)msg.push('Représentation à compléter si possible : '+missing.join(', ')+'.');const deps=new Set(s.roster.map(p=>p.department.trim()).filter(Boolean));if(deps.size>1)msg.push('Plusieurs départements : prévoir une adaptation des actions à chaque territoire.');return msg;}
globalThis.ExcoPack={organisations,globalFields,cleanRoster,newWorkshop,cleanWorkshop,cleanGlobal,enrichSession,hasWork,visibleGroups,units,contributions,ratingRows,aggregateRatings,progress,fingerprint,validatePayload,classifyImport,applyImport,toolTip,rosterWarnings,uuid,copy};
})();

const STORAGE = globalThis.PACK_ROLE==='admin'?'exco-admin-v9-pack1':'exco-parcours-v5';

const SUMMARY_FIELDS = ['phrase','consensus','desaccords','questions','actions','acteurs','moments','communication','pilote','echeance'];

const summaryLabels={phrase:'Phrase choc',consensus:'Consensus',desaccords:'Désaccords',questions:'Questions à confirmer',actions:'Actions d’aller-vers',acteurs:'Acteurs clés',moments:'Moments de contact',communication:'Communication',pilote:'Pilote',echeance:'Échéance'};
const RATINGS = [
  ['pertinence','Pertinence dans cette situation','1 : faible · 5 : forte'],
  ['facilite','Facilité d’usage','1 : difficile · 5 : facile'],
  ['temps','Gain de temps perçu','1 : faible · 5 : élevé'],
  ['equipement','Difficulté d’équipement','1 : faible · 5 : élevée']

const uid = () => globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || 'x'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10);
const clone = x => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));
const str = (s,max=20000) => typeof s==='string' ? s.slice(0,max) : '';
const esc = s => String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const nl = s => esc(s||'').replace(/\n/g,'<br>');
const isObject = x => !!x && typeof x==='object' && !Array.isArray(x);
const journeyById = id => CATALOG.journeys.find(x=>x.id===id);
const kitId = id => ({chat:'santelien',maillage:'ror'}[id] || CATALOG.subcards.find(x=>x.id===id)?.parent || id);
const blankNotes = () => Object.fromEntries(NOTE_FIELDS.map(k=>[k,'']));
const blankSummary = () => Object.fromEntries(SUMMARY_FIELDS.map(k=>[k,'']));
const TIMER_DURATION=45*60*1000;
function newTimer(){return {durationMs:TIMER_DURATION,remainingMs:TIMER_DURATION,deadline:null,phase:'idle'};}
function cleanTimer(x){
  const t=newTimer();if(!isObject(x))return t;
  t.remainingMs=Number.isFinite(x.remainingMs)?Math.max(0,Math.min(TIMER_DURATION,x.remainingMs)):TIMER_DURATION;
  t.phase=['idle','running','paused','finished'].includes(x.phase)?x.phase:'idle';
  t.deadline=t.phase==='running'&&Number.isFinite(x.deadline)?x.deadline:null;
  if(t.phase==='running'&&t.deadline===null)t.phase='paused';
  if(t.phase==='finished')t.remainingMs=0;
  return t;
}
function timerRemaining(timer,now=Date.now()){return Math.max(0,Math.min(TIMER_DURATION,timer.phase==='running'&&Number.isFinite(timer.deadline)?timer.deadline-now:timer.remainingMs));}
function toggleTimer(timer,now=Date.now()){
  const remaining=timerRemaining(timer,now);
  if(timer.phase==='running')return {...timer,remainingMs:remaining,deadline:null,phase:remaining>0?'paused':'finished'};
  const start=remaining>0?remaining:TIMER_DURATION;
  return {...timer,remainingMs:start,deadline:now+start,phase:'running'};
}
function finishTimer(timer,now=Date.now()){return timer.phase==='running'&&timerRemaining(timer,now)===0?{...timer,remainingMs:0,deadline:null,phase:'finished'}:timer;}
function formatTimer(ms){const sec=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(ms/1000));return String(Math.floor(sec/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(sec%60).padStart(2,'0');}
function getCard(kind,id) {
  if (id==='joker-actor') return {id,kind:'actors',name:'Personnage joker',subtitle:'Un acteur non prévu dans les cartes',description:'Précisez le nom ou la fonction de cet acteur.',joker:true};
  if (id==='irritant-libre') return {id,kind:'irritants',name:'Autre irritant',subtitle:'Une objection entendue sur le terrain',description:'Écrivez votre propre irritant.',joker:true};
  if (kind==='tools') return [...CATALOG.tools,...CATALOG.subcards].find(x=>x.id===id);
  return CATALOG[kind]?.find(x=>x.id===id);
}
function entryLabel(kind,e) {const c=getCard(kind,e.cardId);return e.customName?.trim() || (kind==='irritants' ? ((c?.name||'')+' · '+(c?.description||'')) : c?.name) || 'Carte';}
function isJoker(id){return ['joker','joker-actor','irritant-libre'].includes(id);}
function newEntry(cardId){return {id:uid(),cardId,customName:'',notes:blankNotes(),ratings:{}};}
function newSession(name='Groupe 1') {
  const now=new Date().toISOString();
  const s={id:uid(),name,department:'',participants:'',createdAt:now,updatedAt:now,currentJourney:'monique',parts:{},journeys:{},timer:newTimer()};
  return ExcoPack.enrichSession(s);
}
function getJourneyState(session,id=session.currentJourney) {
  if (!session.journeys[id])session.journeys[id]={steps:{},summary:blankSummary()};
  return session.journeys[id];
}
function getStepState(session,no,jid=session.currentJourney){
  const js=getJourneyState(session,jid),key=String(no);
  if(!js.steps[key]) js.steps[key]={actors:[],tools:[],irritants:[],discussion:blankNotes()};
  return js.steps[key];
}
function cleanNotes(x,fields=NOTE_FIELDS){return Object.fromEntries(fields.map(k=>[k,str(x?.[k])]));}
function cleanEntry(x,kind){
  if(!isObject(x)||!getCard(kind,str(x.cardId,80)))return null;
  return {id:uid(),cardId:x.cardId,customName:str(x.customName,180),notes:cleanNotes(x.notes),ratings:Object.fromEntries(RATINGS.map(([k])=>[k,Number.isInteger(x.ratings?.[k])&&x.ratings[k]>=1&&x.ratings[k]<=5?x.ratings[k]:null]))};
}
function cleanSession(x,{newId=false}={}){
  if(!isObject(x)||!isObject(x.journeys))throw Error('Le fichier ne contient pas de données de groupe valides.');
  const s=newSession(str(x.name,180)||'Groupe importé');
  if(!newId&&/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(x.id||''))s.id=x.id;
  s.department=str(x.department,180);s.participants=str(x.participants,2000);
  s.createdAt=str(x.createdAt,60)||s.createdAt;s.updatedAt=str(x.updatedAt,60)||s.updatedAt;
  s.timer=cleanTimer(x.timer);
  if(journeyById(x.currentJourney))s.currentJourney=x.currentJourney;
  if(newId)s.importedFrom=str(x.id,100);
  for(const j of CATALOG.journeys){
    const incoming=x.journeys[j.id];if(!isObject(incoming))continue;
    const js=getJourneyState(s,j.id);js.summary=cleanNotes(incoming.summary,SUMMARY_FIELDS);
    s.parts[j.id]=[0,1,'all'].includes(x.parts?.[j.id])?x.parts[j.id]:0;
    for(const step of j.steps){
      const data=incoming.steps?.[String(step.number)];if(!isObject(data))continue;
      const st=getStepState(s,step.number,j.id);st.discussion=cleanNotes(data.discussion);
      for(const kind of ['actors','tools','irritants']){
        if(!step.key&&kind!=='irritants')continue;
        const ids=new Set();
        st[kind]=(Array.isArray(data[kind])?data[kind].slice(0,100):[]).map(e=>cleanEntry(e,kind)).filter(e=>{
          if(!e)return false;if(isJoker(e.cardId))return true;if(ids.has(e.cardId))return false;ids.add(e.cardId);return true;
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return ExcoPack.enrichSession(s,x);
}
function stats(session,jid){
  const j=journeyById(jid),js=session.journeys[jid]||{steps:{},summary:{}};
  let done=0,irritants=0,irritantsAnswered=0,tools=0,actors=0,notes=0;
  for(const step of j.steps){const st=js.steps[String(step.number)];if(!st)continue;
    if(step.key&&st.actors?.length&&st.tools?.length)done++;
    actors+=st.actors?.length||0;tools+=st.tools?.length||0;
    irritants+=st.irritants?.length||0;
    irritantsAnswered+=(st.irritants||[]).filter(e=>e.notes?.edl?.trim()||e.notes?.leviers?.trim()).length;
    if(Object.values(st.discussion||{}).some(v=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim()))notes++;
  }
  return {done,total:j.steps.filter(x=>x.key).length,irritants,irritantsAnswered,tools,actors,notes,phrase:!!js.summary?.phrase?.trim()};
}
function extractSessions(json){
  if(!isObject(json)||json.format!=='exco-num-v5'||!Array.isArray(json.sessions)||!json.sessions.length)throw Error('Choisissez une sauvegarde JSON du jeu Parcours en cartes (V5 ou ultérieure).');
  if(json.sessions.length>100)throw Error('La sauvegarde contient trop de groupes.');
  return json.sessions.map(x=>cleanSession(x,{newId:true}));
}
function makeBackup(sessions){return {format:'exco-num-v5',version:9,packVersion:'1.0',exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),sourceDate:CATALOG.sourceDate,sessions:clone(sessions)};}
function exportRows(sessions){
  const rows=[];
  for(const session of sessions)for(const j of CATALOG.journeys){const js=session.journeys[j.id];if(!js)continue;
    const base={Groupe:session.name,Identifiant_groupe:session.id,Département:session.department,Participants:session.participants,Parcours:j.title};
    const rowStart=rows.length;
    for(const step of j.steps){const st=js.steps[String(step.number)];if(!st)continue;
      const stageBase={...base,Étape:step.number,Type_étape:step.key?'Moment clé':'Repère',Situation:step.text};
      const flat=Object.entries({actors:'Personnage',tools:'Outil',irritants:'Irritant'}).flatMap(([kind,label])=>(st[kind]||[]).map(e=>({kind,label,e})));
      if(!flat.length&&Object.values(st.discussion||{}).some(Boolean))flat.push({kind:'discussion',label:'Discussion',e:{notes:{},ratings:{}}});
      for(const {kind,label,e} of flat){const row={...stageBase,Type_carte:label,Carte:kind==='discussion'?'':entryLabel(kind,e),Code_carte:e.cardId||''};
        for(const f of NOTE_FIELDS)row[noteLabels[f]+' · carte']=e.notes?.[f]||'';
        for(const [key,labelRating] of RATINGS)row[labelRating]=e.ratings?.[key]??'';
        for(const f of NOTE_FIELDS)row[noteLabels[f]+' · étape']=st.discussion?.[f]||'';
        for(const f of SUMMARY_FIELDS)row[summaryLabels[f]+' · synthèse']=js.summary?.[f]||'';
        rows.push(row);
      }
    }
    if(rows.length===rowStart&&Object.values(js.summary||{}).some(Boolean)){
      const row={...base,Type_carte:'Synthèse'};for(const f of SUMMARY_FIELDS)row[summaryLabels[f]+' · synthèse']=js.summary[f]||'';rows.push(row);
    }
  }
  return rows;
}
function safeCSV(s){let v=String(s??'');if(/^\s*[=+@-]/.test(v))v="'"+v;return '"'+v.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';}
function toCSV(rows){
  if(!rows.length)return '\ufeffGroupe;Parcours;Étape;Type_carte;Carte\r\n';
  const keys=[...new Set(rows.flatMap(Object.keys))];
  return '\ufeff'+[keys.map(safeCSV).join(';'),...rows.map(r=>keys.map(k=>safeCSV(r[k])).join(';'))].join('\r\n');
}

function pickerCards({kind,query='',group='all',mode='main',draft=[]}){
  let list=kind==='actors'?CATALOG.actors:kind==='irritants'?CATALOG.irritants:mode==='sub'?CATALOG.subcards:CATALOG.tools.filter(c=>c.id!=='joker');
  if(group==='selected')list=draft.map(e=>getCard(kind,e.cardId)).filter(Boolean).filter((c,i,a)=>a.findIndex(x=>x.id===c.id)===i);
  else if(group!=='all'&&kind==='actors')list=list.filter(c=>actorCategory(c.id)===group);
  else if(group!=='all'&&kind==='tools')list=list.filter(c=>toolCategory(c.parent||c.id)===group);
  const q=query.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLocaleLowerCase('fr-FR');
  return list.filter(c=>[c.name,c.subtitle,c.description,c.tag].join(' ').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLocaleLowerCase('fr-FR').includes(q));
}
function pageCards(cards,page,size){const pageCount=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(cards.length/size));const current=Math.max(0,Math.min(Number(page)||0,pageCount-1));return {cards:cards.slice(current*size,(current+1)*size),page:current,pageCount,total:cards.length,start:cards.length?current*size+1:0,end:Math.min(cards.length,(current+1)*size)};}
function routeTrack(anchors,width){
  if(!anchors.length)return {path:'',arrows:''};
  let path=`M 8 ${anchors[0].y} L ${anchors[0].x} ${anchors[0].y}`,arrows='';
  anchors.slice(1).forEach((p,index)=>{
    const q=anchors[index],middle=(q.x+p.x)/2;
    path+=` C ${middle} ${q.y} ${middle} ${p.y} ${p.x} ${p.y}`;
    const y=(q.y+p.y)/2;
    arrows+=`<path d="M ${middle-5} ${y-5} l 6 5 l -6 5" fill="none" stroke="#eef5ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;
  });path+=` L ${width-8} ${anchors[anchors.length-1].y}`;
  return {path,arrows};
}
function boardLayout(numbers,width=1440){
  const columns=numbers.length,rows=1,cellWidth=226,gap=18,padding=24,surfaceWidth=Math.max(width-56,columns*cellWidth+(columns-1)*gap+padding*2),effectiveCell=(surfaceWidth-padding*2-gap*(columns-1))/columns;
  const stops=numbers.map((number,index)=>({number,row:0,column:index,lift:index%2?0:36}));
  const track=routeTrack(stops.map(stop=>({x:padding+stop.column*(effectiveCell+gap)+effectiveCell/2,y:120+stop.lift})),surfaceWidth);
  return {columns,rows,stops,...track,width:surfaceWidth,height:420};
}

    ${routeMode==='story'?`<div class="reading-scroll">${renderStory(j,js)}</div>`:routeMode==='text'?renderTextTimeline(j,js):renderTimeline(j,js)}
    <p class="timeline-help">Suivez les numéros. Cliquez sur une scène pour lire la situation, sur <b>Qui ?</b> ou <b>Outils ?</b> pour choisir les cartes, puis sur un picto posé pour noter vos échanges.</p></section>`;
  if(routeMode==='timeline')window.requestAnimationFrame?.(()=>{const viewport=$('ribbonViewport');if(viewport?.dataset.ribbonKey)viewport.scrollLeft=ribbonOffsets[viewport.dataset.ribbonKey]||0;updateBoardTrack();updateRibbonControls();});
}
function activeChapter(j){const stored=session().parts[j.id];return Number.isInteger(stored)&&stored>=0&&stored<j.pages.length?stored:0;}
function renderTimeline(j,js){
  const chapter=activeChapter(j),numbers=j.pages[chapter],layout=boardLayout(numbers,window.innerWidth),story=CATALOG.story[j.id];
  const progress=page=>{const keys=j.pages[page].filter(no=>j.steps.find(step=>step.number===no).key);return {total:keys.length,done:keys.filter(no=>js.steps[String(no)]?.actors.length&&js.steps[String(no)]?.tools.length).length};};
  return `<div class="dimensional-board horizontal-board"><nav class="map-chapters" aria-label="Chapitres du parcours">${j.pages.map((page,index)=>{const st=progress(index);return `<button class="map-chapter ${index===chapter?'active':''}" data-action="chapter" data-page="${index}" aria-pressed="${index===chapter}"><b>${String(index+1).padStart(2,'0')}</b><span><strong>${esc(story.chapters[index])}</strong><small>Étapes ${page[0]} à ${page[page.length-1]}</small></span><em class="${st.done===st.total?'finished':''}" data-tip="${st.done} moment${st.done>1?'s':''} complété${st.done>1?'s':''} sur ${st.total} dans ce chapitre.">${st.done}/${st.total} <i aria-hidden="true">✓</i></em></button>`;}).join('')}</nav>
    <section class="path-map ribbon-board" aria-label="Chapitre ${chapter+1} : ${esc(story.chapters[chapter])}"><div class="ribbon-toolbar"><p id="ribbonInstruction"><span aria-hidden="true">⤳</span> Un seul sens de lecture : <b>de gauche à droite</b></p><div class="ribbon-pan"><span id="ribbonScrollHint">Faites défiler le plateau</span><button id="ribbonBackward" data-action="ribbon-scroll" data-direction="-1" aria-label="Dérouler le plateau vers la gauche">←</button><button id="ribbonForward" data-action="ribbon-scroll" data-direction="1" aria-label="Dérouler le plateau vers la droite">→</button></div></div><div class="ribbon-frame" id="ribbonFrame"><div class="ribbon-viewport" id="ribbonViewport" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="Plateau horizontal : étapes ${numbers[0]} à ${numbers[numbers.length-1]}" aria-describedby="ribbonInstruction" data-ribbon-key="${esc(session().id+':'+j.id+':'+chapter)}"><div class="ribbon-surface" style="--ribbon-count:${numbers.length}"><span class="map-start" aria-hidden="true">${chapter===0?'DÉPART':'LA SUITE'} →</span><svg class="path-track" viewBox="0 0 ${layout.width} ${layout.height}" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path class="track-shadow" d="${layout.path}"/><path class="track-road" d="${layout.path}"/><path class="track-dashes" d="${layout.path}"/><g class="track-arrows">${layout.arrows}</g></svg>${layout.stops.map(position=>renderPathStop(j,j.steps.find(step=>step.number===position.number),js.steps[String(position.number)],position)).join('')}</div></div></div></section>
    <footer class="map-footer"><p class="map-reading"><span aria-hidden="true">→</span>Faites glisser le plateau ou utilisez les flèches.<span class="sr-only" role="status">Chapitre ${chapter+1} sur ${j.pages.length}, étapes ${numbers[0]} à ${numbers[numbers.length-1]}.</span></p><div class="map-page-actions"><button class="map-prev" data-action="chapter" data-page="${chapter-1}" ${chapter===0?'disabled':''}>← Chapitre précédent</button><span>${chapter+1} / ${j.pages.length}</span>${chapter<j.pages.length-1?`<button class="map-next" data-action="chapter" data-page="${chapter+1}">Suite du parcours →</button>`:'<button class="map-next" data-action="summary">Préparer la synthèse ↗</button>'}</div></footer></div>`;
}
function updateBoardTrack(){
  const map=document.querySelector('.path-map'),track=map?.querySelector('.path-track');if(!track)return;
  const bounds=track.getBoundingClientRect();if(bounds.width<1||bounds.height<1)return;
  const anchors=[...map.querySelectorAll('.path-stop')].map(stop=>{const rect=stop.querySelector('.scene-token').getBoundingClientRect();return {x:Math.round((rect.left+rect.width/2-bounds.left)*10)/10,y:Math.round((rect.top+rect.height*.70-bounds.top)*10)/10};});
  const geometry=routeTrack(anchors,bounds.width);track.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${bounds.width} ${bounds.height}`);
  track.querySelectorAll('.track-shadow,.track-road,.track-dashes').forEach(path=>path.setAttribute('d',geometry.path));track.querySelector('.track-arrows').innerHTML=geometry.arrows;
}
function updateRibbonControls(){
  const viewport=$('ribbonViewport');if(!viewport||!Number.isFinite(viewport.clientWidth))return;
  const maximum=Math.max(0,viewport.scrollWidth-viewport.clientWidth),atStart=viewport.scrollLeft<=2,atEnd=viewport.scrollLeft>=maximum-2;
  $('ribbonBackward').disabled=atStart;$('ribbonForward').disabled=atEnd;
  $('ribbonFrame').classList.toggle('can-go-back',!atStart);$('ribbonFrame').classList.toggle('can-go-forward',!atEnd);
  $('ribbonScrollHint').textContent=maximum<=2?'Tout le chapitre est visible':'Glissez ou utilisez les flèches';
  if(viewport.dataset.ribbonKey)ribbonOffsets[viewport.dataset.ribbonKey]=viewport.scrollLeft;
}
function scrollRibbon(direction){
  const viewport=$('ribbonViewport');if(!viewport)return;
  const maximum=Math.max(0,viewport.scrollWidth-viewport.clientWidth),next=Math.max(0,Math.min(maximum,viewport.scrollLeft+direction*Math.max(244,viewport.clientWidth*.7)));
  viewport.scrollTo?.({left:next,behavior:window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?'auto':'smooth'});
}
function renderPathStop(j,step,data,position){
  const st=data||{actors:[],tools:[],irritants:[],discussion:{}},scene=CATALOG.story[j.id].scenes[step.number-1],done=!!(step.key&&st.actors.length&&st.tools.length),hasNotes=Object.values(st.discussion||{}).some(Boolean)||['actors','tools','irritants'].some(kind=>st[kind].some(e=>Object.values(e.notes||{}).some(Boolean)));
  return `<article class="path-stop ribbon-stop ${step.key?'key':'repere'} ${done?'done':''}" data-step="${step.number}" style="--ribbon-lift:${position.lift}px"><div class="stop-visual"><button class="scene-token" data-action="step-info" data-step="${step.number}" data-tip="${esc(step.text)}" aria-label="Étape ${step.number} : ${esc(scene[0])}. Lire la situation.">${renderMiniature(j,step.number)}</button><span class="stop-number" aria-hidden="true">${step.number}</span><div class="stop-heading"><span class="stop-type">${step.key?'Moment clé '+step.hole:'Repère'}</span><button class="stop-info" data-action="step-info" data-step="${step.number}" data-tip="${esc(step.text)}" aria-label="Descriptif de l’étape ${step.number}">i</button><button class="stop-irritant ${step.irritantExpected?'expected':''} ${st.irritants.length?'selected':''}" data-action="pick" data-kind="irritants" data-step="${step.number}" data-tip="${esc(step.irritantExpected?'Irritant attendu ici. ':'')}Choisir les irritants de cette étape." aria-label="Irritants de l’étape ${step.number}">!${st.irritants.length?`<small>${st.irritants.length}</small>`:''}</button></div></div><div class="stop-copy"><h3><button data-action="step-info" data-step="${step.number}" data-tip="${esc(step.text)}">${esc(scene[0])}</button></h3></div>
    ${step.key?`<div class="stop-dock">${renderIconLane(step.number,'actors',st.actors,2)}${renderIconLane(step.number,'tools',st.tools,2)}</div>`:`<div class="stop-context"><span aria-hidden="true">○</span><div>Un repère du récit<button data-action="step-info" data-step="${step.number}">Lire la situation ↗</button></div></div>`}
    <div class="stop-footer"><button data-action="discussion" data-step="${step.number}" data-tip="Saisir les freins, leviers, irritants et éléments de langage de cette étape."><span aria-hidden="true">✎</span> ${hasNotes?'Échanges saisis':'Échanges'}${hasNotes?' <b>•</b>':''}</button>${done?'<span class="stop-done">✓ Choix posés</span>':step.key?'<span class="stop-awaiting">À vous de jouer</span>':''}</div></article>`;
}
/* Miniatures SVG : décors en perspective et personnages du kit, sans réseau. */
function renderMiniature(j,number){
  const spec=sceneArt(j.id,number),variant=spec.base,rose=j.steps[number-1].key,accent=rose?'#e99288':'#6b9ed8';
  const pt=(x,y,z=0)=>[90+(x-y)*.866,91+(x+y)*.45-z];
  const points=values=>values.map(v=>pt(...v).map(n=>n.toFixed(1)).join(',')).join(' ');
  const poly=(values,fill)=>`<polygon points="${points(values)}" fill="${fill}" stroke="#fff" stroke-width=".45" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`;
  const box=(x,y,z,w,d,h,front='#eff5fd',side='#b2c9e4',top='#fff')=>poly([[x,y,z+h],[x+w,y,z+h],[x+w,y+d,z+h],[x,y+d,z+h]],top)+poly([[x,y+d,z],[x+w,y+d,z],[x+w,y+d,z+h],[x,y+d,z+h]],front)+poly([[x+w,y,z],[x+w,y+d,z],[x+w,y+d,z+h],[x+w,y,z+h]],side);
  const windowFace=(x,y,z,w=7,h=10)=>poly([[x,y,z],[x+w,y,z],[x+w,y,z+h],[x,y,z+h]],'#80a6ce');
  const cross=(x,y,z,color='#477daf')=>poly([[x-3,y,z-9],[x+3,y,z-9],[x+3,y,z-3],[x+9,y,z-3],[x+9,y,z+3],[x+3,y,z+3],[x+3,y,z+9],[x-3,y,z+9],[x-3,y,z+3],[x-9,y,z+3],[x-9,y,z-3],[x-3,y,z-3]],color);
  const tree=`<path d="M 36 78 v 17" stroke="#7894b5" stroke-width="3"/><ellipse cx="36" cy="69" rx="12" ry="16" fill="#91afd0"/><ellipse cx="31" cy="66" rx="6" ry="10" fill="#b6cce5"/>`;
  let drawing='';
  if(['hospital','maternity','residence','clinic','pharmacy'].includes(variant)){
    const big=['hospital','maternity','residence'].includes(variant),height=big?54:39;
    drawing=box(-34,-12,0,43,32,height)+box(9,1,0,18,19,26,'#dce9f8','#9cb7d7','#f5f9ff');
    drawing+=cross(-12,20.3,height-17,variant==='pharmacy'?'#7193bc':accent);

    if(big)drawing+=box(-36,-14,height,47,36,4,'#6d90bb','#5a7eab','#9ab9dc');

  }else if(['home','team','notes','rehab'].includes(variant)){
    drawing=box(-29,-13,0,37,30,33,'#fcfcff','#c5d6ea','#f6faff');
    drawing+=poly([[-34,-17,33],[-13,-17,54],[-13,22,54],[-34,22,33]],'#a3bbd8')+poly([[-13,-17,54],[13,-17,33],[13,22,33],[-13,22,54]],'#7495bc');
    drawing+=windowFace(-22,17.4,8,10,17)+windowFace(-5,17.4,14,8,10)+tree;
    if(variant==='notes')drawing+='<g transform="translate(101 38) rotate(8)"><rect width="34" height="44" rx="4" fill="#e9b7ae"/><rect x="3" y="2" width="29" height="38" rx="2" fill="#fffdf9"/><path d="M8 13h18M8 19h15M8 25h18M8 31h11" stroke="#8fa5c1" stroke-width="2"/></g>';
  }else if(variant==='ambulance'){
    drawing=box(-40,-9,5,56,26,27,'#f4f8ff','#b4cae6','#fff')+box(16,-7,5,18,24,22,'#edf4ff','#8dacd4','#c9ddf1');
    drawing+=cross(-14,17.3,19,'#e4877e');
    drawing+=windowFace(18,17.4,16,11,9)+box(-15,-3,32,13,10,4,'#dc837e','#ba686f','#efb0a3');
    drawing+='<ellipse cx="65" cy="102" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#6581a5"/><ellipse cx="115" cy="112" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#6581a5"/><ellipse cx="65" cy="102" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#c6d8eb"/><ellipse cx="115" cy="112" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#c6d8eb"/>';

function renderTextTimeline(j,js){return `<div class="text-timeline">${j.pages.map((numbers,page)=>`<section class="text-timeline-chapter"><div class="timeline-chapter"><b>${page+1}</b><span>${esc(CATALOG.story[j.id].chapters[page])}</span></div><div class="text-timeline-rows">${numbers.map(no=>renderTimelineStep(j.steps.find(s=>s.number===no),js.steps[String(no)],true)).join('')}</div></section>`).join('')}</div>`;}
function renderTimelineStep(step,data,textMode=false){
  const st=data||{actors:[],tools:[],irritants:[],discussion:{}},scene=CATALOG.story[currentJourney().id].scenes[step.number-1],done=step.key&&st.actors.length&&st.tools.length,note=Object.values(st.discussion||{}).some(Boolean);
  const head=`<div class="time-step-head"><span class="time-step-number">${step.number}</span><span class="time-step-type">${step.key?'Moment '+step.hole:'Repère'}</span><button class="step-information" data-action="step-info" data-step="${step.number}" data-tip="${esc(step.text)}" aria-label="Lire le descriptif de l’étape ${step.number}">i</button><button class="time-irritant ${step.irritantExpected?'expected':''} ${st.irritants.length?'selected':''}" data-action="pick" data-kind="irritants" data-step="${step.number}" data-tip="${esc(step.irritantExpected?'Irritant attendu. ':'')}Ajouter les irritants de cette étape." aria-label="Irritants de l’étape ${step.number}">!${st.irritants.length?`<small>${st.irritants.length}</small>`:''}</button></div>`;
  const title=`<h3><button data-action="step-info" data-step="${step.number}" data-tip="${esc(step.text)}">${esc(scene[0])}</button></h3>`;
  const choices=step.key?`<div class="time-step-choices">${renderIconLane(step.number,'actors',st.actors,textMode?2:undefined)}${renderIconLane(step.number,'tools',st.tools,textMode?2:undefined)}</div>`:`<div class="time-repere"><span aria-hidden="true">${scene[2]}</span><small>${esc(scene[1])}</small></div>`;
  const foot=`<div class="time-step-foot"><button data-action="discussion" data-step="${step.number}" data-tip="${note?'Modifier':'Saisir'} les freins, leviers et éléments de langage." aria-label="Échanges de l’étape ${step.number}">✎${textMode?'':' Échanges'}${note?' <b>•</b>':''}</button>${done?'<span class="step-done" data-tip="Des personnages et des outils ont été choisis pour cette étape.">✓</span>':''}</div>`;
  return `<article class="time-step ${step.key?'key':'repere'} ${done?'done':''} ${textMode?'text-step':''}" data-step="${step.number}">${head}${title}${choices}${foot}</article>`;
}
function renderIconLane(no,kind,entries,displayLimit){
  const label=kind==='actors'?'Qui ?':'Outils ?',limit=displayLimit||(window.innerWidth>=1250?3:2);
  const icons=entries.slice(0,limit).map(e=>{const c=getCard(kind,e.cardId),name=kind==='tools'?displayToolName(e):entryLabel(kind,e);let visual;
    if(isJoker(e.cardId))visual='<span class="free-choice">★</span>';
    else if(kind==='actors')visual=`<span class="portrait-token"><img src="${c.image}" alt=""></span>`;
    else visual=`<img class="${c.logo?'official-logo':'generic-tool'}" src="${c.logo||c.image}" alt="">`;
    return `<button class="timeline-icon ${kind==='actors'?'actor':'tool'}" data-action="discussion" data-step="${no}" data-entry="${e.id}" data-tip="${esc(name)}${kind==='tools'?' · '+esc(ExcoPack.toolTip(c)):''} · Ouvrir la fiche d’échange" aria-label="${esc(name)} : ouvrir la fiche d’échange">${visual}</button>`;
  }).join('');
  return `<div class="icon-lane ${kind}"><button class="lane-picker" data-action="pick" data-kind="${kind}" data-step="${no}" aria-label="Choisir les ${kind==='actors'?'personnages':'outils'} de l’étape ${no}">${label}<small>${entries.length||'+'}</small></button><div class="lane-icons">${icons}${entries.length>limit?`<button class="more-choices" data-action="pick" data-kind="${kind}" data-step="${no}" data-tip="Voir les ${entries.length} cartes choisies pour cette étape." aria-label="Voir les ${entries.length} cartes choisies">+${entries.length-limit}</button>`:''}${!entries.length?`<button class="empty-lane" data-action="pick" data-kind="${kind}" data-step="${no}" aria-label="Ajouter ${kind==='actors'?'des personnages':'des outils'} à l’étape ${no}">+</button>`:''}</div></div>`;
}
function openStepInfo(no){const j=currentJourney(),step=j.steps.find(s=>s.number===Number(no));if(!step)return;M={type:'step-info'};showDialog({title:CATALOG.story[j.id].scenes[step.number-1][0],eyebrow:`${j.title} · étape ${step.number} · ${step.key?'moment clé '+step.hole:'repère'}`,body:`<p class="step-full-description">${esc(step.text)}</p><p class="small">${step.key?'Plusieurs cartes personnages et outils peuvent être choisies si le groupe justifie ses propositions.':'Ce repère situe le parcours. Aucun personnage ni outil ne se pose ici.'}</p>`,footer:`<button class="btn secondary" data-action="cancel-dialog">Fermer</button><div>${step.key?`<button class="btn secondary" data-action="pick" data-kind="actors" data-step="${step.number}">Qui ?</button><button class="btn coral" data-action="pick" data-kind="tools" data-step="${step.number}">Outils ?</button>`:''}<button class="btn" data-action="discussion" data-step="${step.number}">Échanges</button></div>`,narrow:true});}
function renderStage(step,data){
  const st=data||{actors:[],tools:[],irritants:[],discussion:{}},note=Object.values(st.discussion||{}).some(Boolean),scene=CATALOG.story[currentJourney().id].scenes[step.number-1],done=step.key&&st.actors.length&&st.tools.length;
  return `<article class="stage ${step.key?'key':'repere'} ${done?'choices-done':''}" data-step="${step.number}"><div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-number">${step.number}</span><div><span class="stage-type">${step.key?'À VOUS DE JOUER · MOMENT '+step.hole:'LE RÉCIT · REPÈRE'}</span><span class="scene-location">${scene[2]} ${esc(scene[1])}</span></div><button class="irritant-btn ${step.irritantExpected?'expected':''} ${st.irritants.length?'has-cards':''}" data-action="pick" data-kind="irritants" data-step="${step.number}" data-tip="${esc(step.irritantExpected?'Zone où un irritant est attendu. ':'')}Choisir un ou plusieurs irritants et formuler une réponse." aria-label="Irritants de l’étape ${step.number}">!${st.irritants.length?'<small>'+st.irritants.length+'</small>':''}</button></div><h3 class="scene-title">${esc(scene[0])}</h3><p class="stage-text">${esc(step.text)}</p>
  ${step.key?`<div class="stage-actions"><button class="place-btn actors" data-action="pick" data-kind="actors" data-step="${step.number}"><span>Qui ?</span><span class="count">${st.actors.length||'+'}</span></button><button class="place-btn tools" data-action="pick" data-kind="tools" data-step="${step.number}"><span>Outils ?</span><span class="count">${st.tools.length||'+'}</span></button></div>`:'<p class="repere-foot">Un repère pour comprendre la suite de l’histoire.</p>'}
    <div class="placed-area">${['actors','tools','irritants'].flatMap(kind=>st[kind].map(e=>`<button class="placed-chip ${kind==='tools'?'tool':kind==='irritants'?'irritant':''}" data-action="discussion" data-step="${step.number}" data-entry="${e.id}" data-tip="${esc(entryLabel(kind,e))} · Cliquer pour justifier ce choix">${imageFor(kind,e)}${kind==='irritants'?'<b>!</b>':''}<span>${esc(kind==='tools'?displayToolName(e):entryLabel(kind,e))}</span></button>`)).join('')}</div>
    <div class="stage-foot"><button class="text-btn" data-action="discussion" data-step="${step.number}">${note?'Modifier les échanges':'Échanges · freins, leviers, EDL'}</button><span class="stage-note-status">${done?'✓ Choix posés':note?'✓ Notes':''}</span></div></article>`;
}
function renderStory(j,js){
  const no=storyFocus[j.id]||1,step=j.steps.find(x=>x.number===no)||j.steps[0],chapter=j.pages.findIndex(page=>page.includes(step.number)),story=CATALOG.story[j.id];
  return `<div class="story-step-nav" aria-label="Scènes du parcours">${j.steps.map(x=>{const st=js.steps[String(x.number)],done=x.key&&st?.actors.length&&st?.tools.length;return `<button class="${x.key?'key':''} ${x.number===step.number?'active':''} ${done?'done':''}" data-action="story-step" data-step="${x.number}" data-tip="${esc(story.scenes[x.number-1][0])}" aria-label="Scène ${x.number} : ${esc(story.scenes[x.number-1][0])}" aria-pressed="${x.number===step.number}">${x.number}${done?'<small>✓</small>':''}</button>`}).join('')}</div><div class="story-focus"><div class="story-setting"><p class="eyebrow">Chapitre ${chapter+1} / 2</p><h2>${esc(story.chapters[chapter])}</h2><img src="${getCard('actors',j.id).image}" alt="${esc(j.name)}"><p>Scène ${step.number} sur ${j.steps.length}</p><span>${step.key?'À votre groupe de jouer':'Le récit continue'}</span></div><div class="story-scene">${renderStage(step,js.steps[String(step.number)])}</div></div><div class="story-controls"><button class="btn secondary" data-action="story-step" data-step="${step.number-1}" ${step.number===1?'disabled':''}>← Scène précédente</button><span>${step.number} / ${j.steps.length}</span><button class="btn coral" data-action="story-step" data-step="${step.number+1}" ${step.number===j.steps.length?'disabled':''}>${step.number===j.steps.length?'Fin du parcours':'Continuer l’histoire →'}</button></div>`;
}

function showDialog({title,eyebrow='',subtitle='',body='',footer='',narrow=false}){
  hideTooltip();lastFocus=document.activeElement;
  $('dialog').classList.toggle('narrow',narrow);$('dialog').classList.toggle('picker-dialog',M?.type==='pick');$('dialogTitle').textContent=title;$('dialogEyebrow').textContent=eyebrow;$('dialogSubtitle').textContent=subtitle;$('dialogBody').innerHTML=body;$('dialogFooter').innerHTML=footer;
  if(!$('dialog').open)$('dialog').showModal();
}
function closeDialog(){hideTooltip();if($('dialog').open)$('dialog').close();M=null;if(lastFocus?.isConnected)lastFocus.focus();}
function openPicker(stepNo,kind){
  const j=currentJourney(),step=j.steps.find(x=>x.number===Number(stepNo));
  if(!step||(kind!=='irritants'&&!step.key))return;
  const st=getStepState(session(),step.number);
  M={type:'pick',kind,step:step.number,jid:j.id,draft:clone(st[kind]),original:clone(st[kind]),query:'',group:'all',mode:'main',page:0,editJoker:null};
  const label={actors:'Qui intervient ?',tools:'Quels outils mobiliser ?',irritants:'Quel irritant mettre en débat ?'}[kind];
  showDialog({title:label,eyebrow:`${j.title} · scène ${step.number}${step.key?' · moment clé '+step.hole:''}`,subtitle:'Cliquez pour choisir plusieurs cartes. Votre sélection reste visible en bas de la fenêtre.',body:`<div class="picker-shell"><div class="picker-toolbar"><label class="search"><input id="cardSearch" type="search" placeholder="Trouver une carte…" aria-label="Rechercher une carte"></label>${kind==='tools'?'<div class="filter-tabs"><button class="active" data-action="picker-mode" data-mode="main">Les services</button><button data-action="picker-mode" data-mode="sub">Usages précis</button></div>':'<span class="picker-small-hint">Plusieurs cartes possibles</span>'}<button class="btn joker-shortcut" data-action="picker-joker">★ ${kind==='irritants'?'Irritant libre':'Carte joker'}</button></div><div id="pickerCategories" class="picker-categories"></div><div class="picker-topline"><button class="text-btn" data-action="picker-context">Relire la situation</button><span id="pickerRange"></span></div><div class="picker-deck"><div id="pickerGrid" class="picker-grid ${kind==='actors'?'actors':''}"></div><aside id="cardInfoPanel" class="card-detail-drawer" hidden aria-label="Détail d’une carte"></aside></div><div id="pickerPagination" class="picker-pagination"></div><div id="jokerForms" class="joker-forms"></div><div id="selectionTray" class="selection-tray"></div><p id="pickerError" class="error-text" role="alert"></p></div>`,footer:'<span id="selectionCount" class="small"></span><div><button class="btn secondary" data-action="cancel-dialog">Annuler</button><button class="btn coral" data-action="save-picker">Placer les cartes →</button></div>'});
  renderPicker();
}
function getPickerCards(){
  return pickerCards(M);
}
function renderPicker(){
  hideTooltip();
  const cards=getPickerCards(),columns=window.innerWidth>=1100?6:window.innerWidth>=760?4:2,size=columns*(window.innerHeight>=650?2:1),page=pageCards(cards,M.page,size);
  M.page=page.page;M.pageCount=page.pageCount;
  const categories=M.kind==='actors'?ACTOR_GROUPS:M.kind==='tools'?TOOL_GROUPS:[['all','Tous les irritants'],['selected','Ma sélection']];
  $('pickerCategories').innerHTML=categories.map(([id,label])=>`<button class="${M.group===id?'active':''}" data-action="picker-group" data-group="${id}" aria-pressed="${M.group===id}">${label}</button>`).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-action="picker-mode"]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.mode===M.mode));
  $('pickerGrid').style.setProperty('--deck-columns',columns);
  $('pickerGrid').innerHTML=page.cards.map(c=>{
    const selected=M.draft.some(e=>e.cardId===c.id),joker=isJoker(c.id),description=M.kind==='tools'?ExcoPack.toolTip(c):(c.description||c.subtitle||'');
    const visual=M.kind==='actors'&&!joker?`<img class="actor-image" src="${c.image}" alt="">`:M.kind==='irritants'?`<div class="card-icon irritant">${joker?'+':'!'}</div>`:joker?'<div class="card-icon joker">★</div>':c.logo?`<div class="solution-logo"><img src="${c.logo}" alt="Logo ${esc(c.parent?getCard('tools',c.parent).name:c.name)}"></div>`:`<div class="card-icon"><img src="${c.image}" alt=""></div>`;
    return `<div class="option-card ${M.kind==='actors'?'actor':''} ${M.kind==='irritants'?'irritant':''} ${selected?'selected':''} ${joker?'joker':''} ${c.parent?'subcard':''}"><span class="option-check" aria-hidden="true">✓</span><button class="select-card" data-action="toggle-card" data-card="${c.id}" aria-pressed="${selected}" data-tip="${esc(description)}">${visual}<h3>${esc(c.name)}</h3>${c.subtitle?`<p class="card-subtitle">${esc(c.parent?'Sous-carte · '+getCard('tools',c.parent).name:c.subtitle)}</p>`:''}${M.kind==='irritants'?`<p class="card-desc">${esc(c.description||'Saisissez l’objection rencontrée.')}</p>`:''}</button>${M.kind!=='actors'?`<button class="info-btn" data-action="card-info" data-card="${c.id}" aria-label="Détail de ${esc(c.name)}">i</button>`:''}</div>`;
  }).join('')||'<div class="empty">Aucune carte ne correspond à cette recherche.</div>';
  $('pickerRange').textContent=page.total?`${page.start}–${page.end} sur ${page.total} cartes`:'Aucun résultat';
  $('pickerPagination').innerHTML=`<button class="btn secondary small" data-action="picker-page" data-page="${page.page-1}" ${page.page===0?'disabled':''}>← Précédentes</button><div>${Array.from({length:page.pageCount},(_,i)=>`<button class="page-dot ${i===page.page?'active':''}" data-action="picker-page" data-page="${i}" aria-label="Page ${i+1}" aria-pressed="${i===page.page}">${i+1}</button>`).join('')}</div><button class="btn secondary small" data-action="picker-page" data-page="${page.page+1}" ${page.page===page.pageCount-1?'disabled':''}>Suivantes →</button>`;
  renderSelectionTray();
}
function renderSelectionTray(){
  $('selectionCount').textContent=M.draft.length+' carte'+(M.draft.length>1?'s':'')+' sélectionnée'+(M.draft.length>1?'s':'');
  $('selectionTray').innerHTML='<strong>Votre sélection</strong><div class="selection-tokens">'+M.draft.map(e=>`<span class="selection-token"><span>${esc(entryLabel(M.kind,e))}</span>${isJoker(e.cardId)?`<button data-action="edit-joker" data-entry="${e.id}" aria-label="Modifier ce joker">✎</button>`:''}<button data-action="remove-draft" data-entry="${e.id}" aria-label="Retirer ${esc(entryLabel(M.kind,e))}">×</button></span>`).join('')+(!M.draft.length?'<span class="small">Cliquez sur les cartes pour composer votre réponse.</span>':'')+'</div>';
  const e=M.draft.find(e=>e.id===M.editJoker);
  $('jokerForms').innerHTML=e?`<div class="joker-form"><label>${M.kind==='actors'?'Nom ou fonction de l’acteur':M.kind==='tools'?'Nom du service proposé':'Votre irritant'}<input data-joker-name="${e.id}" value="${esc(e.customName)}" maxlength="180" placeholder="Nommez votre carte libre"></label><button class="btn small" data-action="finish-joker">Garder ce joker</button></div>`:'';
}
function toggleCard(id){
  const at=M.draft.findIndex(e=>e.cardId===id);
  if(at>=0)M.draft.splice(at,1);else M.draft.push(clone(M.original.find(e=>e.cardId===id)||newEntry(id)));
  renderPicker();document.querySelector('[data-action="toggle-card"][data-card="'+id+'"]')?.focus({preventScroll:true});
}
function addPickerJoker(){const id=M.kind==='actors'?'joker-actor':M.kind==='tools'?'joker':'irritant-libre';let entry=M.draft.find(e=>e.cardId===id&&!e.customName.trim());if(!entry){entry=newEntry(id);M.draft.push(entry);}M.editJoker=entry.id;renderSelectionTray();document.querySelector('[data-joker-name="'+entry.id+'"]')?.focus();}
function savePicker(){
  const missing=M.draft.filter(e=>isJoker(e.cardId)&&!e.customName.trim());
  if(missing.length){M.editJoker=missing[0].id;renderSelectionTray();$('pickerError').textContent='Nommez la carte joker avant de valider.';document.querySelector('[data-joker-name="'+missing[0].id+'"]')?.focus();return;}
  getStepState(session(),M.step,M.jid)[M.kind]=clone(M.draft);
  persist();closeDialog();render();toast('Les cartes ont été placées. Cliquez sur une carte pour renseigner sa fiche.');
}
function cardInfo(id){
  const c=getCard(M.kind,id);if(!c)return;
  const node=$('cardInfoPanel'),children=M.kind==='tools'?CATALOG.subcards.filter(x=>x.parent===c.id):[];
  node.innerHTML=`<button class="close-btn" data-action="hide-info" aria-label="Fermer le détail">×</button>${M.kind==='tools'?toolSheetMarkup(c):'<h3>'+esc(c.name)+'</h3><p>'+esc(c.description||'')+'</p>'}${children.length?`<button class="btn soft" data-action="related-subcards" data-parent="${c.id}">Voir les ${children.length} usages précis</button>`:''}`;node.hidden=false;
}
function notesEditor(notes,scope){
  const fields=[['why',scope==='irritants'?'Pourquoi cet irritant ici ?':'Pourquoi ce choix à cette étape ?'],['freins','Freins rencontrés'],['irritants','Irritants ou objections du terrain'],['leviers','Leviers et réponse proposée'],['edl','Élément de langage à retenir'],['accord','Points d’accord / consensus'],['desaccord','Désaccords ou limites'],['question','Question restant à confirmer'],['action','Prochaine action d’accompagnement'],['acteurCle','Acteur clé à mobiliser'],['moment','Bon moment pour aller vers'],['canal','Canal / manière de communiquer'],['pilote','Pilote de l’action'],['echeance','Échéance']];
  return `<div class="form-grid">${fields.map(([k,label])=>`<div class="field ${['why','edl','action'].includes(k)?'full':''}"><label for="note-${k}">${label}</label>${['pilote','echeance','acteurCle','moment','canal'].includes(k)?`<input id="note-${k}" data-note="${k}" value="${esc(notes[k])}" maxlength="2000">`:`<textarea id="note-${k}" data-note="${k}" rows="2">${esc(notes[k])}</textarea>`}</div>`).join('')}<div class="field"><label for="note-statut">Statut de la réponse du groupe</label><select id="note-statut" data-note="statut">${['','À discuter','Consensus','Désaccord','À confirmer','Usage local','Établi','En vigueur','Annoncé / en déploiement'].map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x)}" ${notes.statut===x?'selected':''}>${x||'Non renseigné'}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label for="note-source">Source / point à vérifier</label><input id="note-source" data-note="source" value="${esc(notes.source)}"></div></div>`;
}
function openDiscussion(stepNo,entryId=''){
  const j=currentJourney(),step=j.steps.find(x=>x.number===Number(stepNo));if(!step)return;
  M={type:'discussion',jid:j.id,step:step.number,draft:clone(getStepState(session(),step.number)),target:entryId||'stage'};
  showDialog({title:'La discussion du groupe',eyebrow:`${j.title} · étape ${step.number}`,subtitle:step.text,body:'<div class="discussion-layout"><nav class="discussion-nav" id="discussionNav" aria-label="Discussion par carte"></nav><div id="discussionMain" class="discussion-main"></div></div>',footer:'<span class="small">Les notes et étoiles sont propres à cette étape du parcours.</span><div><button class="btn secondary" data-action="cancel-dialog">Annuler</button><button class="btn coral" data-action="save-discussion">Enregistrer les échanges</button></div>'});
  renderDiscussion();
}
function discussionTarget(){
  if(M.target==='stage')return {kind:'stage',entry:null,notes:M.draft.discussion};
  for(const kind of ['actors','tools','irritants']){const entry=M.draft[kind].find(e=>e.id===M.target);if(entry)return {kind,entry,notes:entry.notes};}
  M.target='stage';return {kind:'stage',entry:null,notes:M.draft.discussion};
}
function renderDiscussion(){
  const t=discussionTarget();
  $('discussionNav').innerHTML=`<button data-action="discussion-target" data-target="stage" class="${M.target==='stage'?'active':''}">Discussion de l’étape</button>`+['actors','tools','irritants'].map(kind=>`<div class="nav-label">${{actors:'Personnages',tools:'Outils',irritants:'Irritants'}[kind]}</div>`+M.draft[kind].map(e=>`<button class="${e.id===M.target?'active':''}" data-action="discussion-target" data-target="${e.id}">${esc(kind==='tools'?displayToolName(e):entryLabel(kind,e))}</button>`).join('')).join('');
  const title=t.entry?entryLabel(t.kind,t.entry):'Ce que le groupe retient pour cette étape';
  $('discussionMain').innerHTML=`<h3>${esc(title)}</h3><p class="discussion-meta">${t.kind==='irritants'?'Formulez la réponse que vous feriez au professionnel.':t.kind==='stage'?'Les enseignements communs de ce moment. Vous pouvez aussi préciser chaque carte dans la liste.':'Justifiez la pertinence de cette carte dans la situation.'}</p>${t.kind==='tools'?renderRatings(t.entry):''}${notesEditor(t.notes,t.kind)}${t.kind==='tools'||t.kind==='irritants'?renderKit(t):''}${t.entry?'<div style="margin-top:15px"><button class="text-btn danger-btn" data-action="remove-discussion-entry">Retirer cette carte du moment</button></div>':''}`;
}
function renderRatings(entry){return `<div class="divider-title">L’appréciation du groupe</div><div class="rating-grid">${RATINGS.map(([k,label,help])=>`<div class="rating-item"><label>${label}</label><p class="rating-help">${help}</p><div class="stars" role="group" aria-label="${label}">${[1,2,3,4,5].map(i=>`<button class="${(entry.ratings[k]||0)>=i?'on':''}" data-action="rating" data-key="${k}" data-value="${i}" aria-label="${label} : ${i} sur 5" aria-pressed="${entry.ratings[k]===i}">★</button>`).join('')}<button class="reset-rating" data-action="rating" data-key="${k}" data-value="0" aria-label="Effacer la note pour ${label}">×</button><span class="stars-output">${entry.ratings[k]?entry.ratings[k]+'/5':'Non évalué'}</span></div></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="divider-title">Les échanges à conserver</div>`;}
function renderKit(t){
  let ids=t.kind==='tools'?[kitId(t.entry.cardId)]:({i1:['santelien','mss','dmp'],i2:['dmp'],i3:['dmp','santelien'],i4:['dmp'],i5:['mes'],i6:['santelien','mss'],i7:['santelien','mss'],i8:['telesante'],i9:['via'],i10:['santelien'],i11:['ror','ressources-cpts'],i12:['ordonnance']}[t.entry.cardId]||[]);
  ids=[...new Set(ids)].filter(id=>CATALOG.kit[id]);if(!ids.length)return '';
  return `<details class="kit"><summary>Consulter les fiches et éléments de langage du kit fourni</summary><p class="source-date">Référence fournie par l’organisateur · ${CATALOG.sourceDate}. Les notes du groupe restent distinctes.</p>${ids.map(id=>`<h3 style="margin-top:17px;font-size:19px">${esc(getCard('tools',id)?.name||id)}</h3>${Object.entries(CATALOG.kit[id]).map(([label,text])=>`<h4>${esc(label)}</h4><p>${esc(text)}</p>`).join('')}`).join('')}<details class="kit"><summary>Points signalés à confirmer dans l’annexe</summary>${CATALOG.points.map(x=>'<p>'+esc(x)+'</p>').join('')}</details></details>`;
}
function saveDiscussion(){getJourneyState(session(),M.jid).steps[String(M.step)]=clone(M.draft);persist();closeDialog();render();toast('Les échanges du groupe ont été enregistrés.');}

    <section class="synthesis-card phrase"><h2>La phrase choc du groupe</h2><textarea data-summary="phrase" rows="2" placeholder="Une phrase simple à réutiliser auprès des professionnels…">${esc(sum.phrase)}</textarea></section>
    <section class="synthesis-card"><h2>Consensus et points ouverts</h2><div class="form-grid">${[['consensus','Nos points d’accord'],['desaccords','Nos désaccords'],['questions','Les questions à confirmer']].map(([k,label])=>`<div class="field ${k==='questions'?'full':''}"><label>${label}</label><textarea data-summary="${k}" rows="3">${esc(sum[k])}</textarea></div>`).join('')}</div></section>
    <section class="synthesis-card"><h2>La première démarche d’aller-vers</h2><div class="form-grid">${[['actions','Action ou démonstration à proposer'],['acteurs','Acteurs clés à mobiliser'],['moments','Bon moment pour prendre contact'],['communication','Canal et message de prise de contact'],['pilote','Qui porte la suite ?'],['echeance','À quel horizon ?']].map(([k,label])=>`<div class="field ${k==='actions'?'full':''}"><label>${label}</label><textarea data-summary="${k}" rows="2">${esc(sum[k])}</textarea></div>`).join('')}</div></section>
    <section class="synthesis-card"><h2>Les choix et échanges par étape</h2><div class="summary-choice">${j.steps.filter(st=>{const x=js.steps[String(st.number)];return x&&(x.actors.length||x.tools.length||x.irritants.length||Object.values(x.discussion).some(Boolean));}).map(st=>summaryStage(st,js.steps[String(st.number)])).join('')||'<p class="small">Aucun choix enregistré. Revenez au plateau pour placer les cartes.</p>'}</div></section>
    <section class="synthesis-card"><h2>Récupérer le travail du groupe</h2><p class="small" style="margin-bottom:13px">La sauvegarde JSON conserve toutes les saisies des trois parcours. Le CSV s’ouvre dans Excel. Le compte rendu HTML permet une restitution lisible et une impression PDF.</p><div class="exports"><button class="btn" data-action="export-json">Sauvegarde JSON</button><button class="btn secondary" data-action="export-csv">Détails pour Excel · CSV</button><button class="btn secondary" data-action="export-report">Compte rendu illustré · HTML</button><button class="btn secondary" data-action="transfer">Rassembler plusieurs groupes</button></div></section>`;
}
function summaryStage(step,st){
  const notes=st.discussion;
  return `<div class="summary-stage"><h3>Étape ${step.number}${step.key?' · moment clé n° '+step.hole:' · repère'}</h3><p class="small" style="margin-bottom:8px">${esc(step.text)}</p><dl class="summary-step-grid"><dt>Personnages</dt><dd>${st.actors.map(e=>esc(entryLabel('actors',e))).join(', ')||'—'}</dd><dt>Outils</dt><dd class="summary-tools">${st.tools.map(e=>'<span>'+esc(displayToolName(e))+'</span>').join('')||'—'}</dd><dt>Irritants</dt><dd>${st.irritants.map(e=>esc(entryLabel('irritants',e))).join('\n')||'—'}</dd>${[['why','Pourquoi'],['freins','Freins'],['leviers','Leviers'],['edl','Éléments de langage'],['accord','Accords'],['desaccord','Désaccords'],['question','À confirmer'],['action','Action']].filter(([k])=>notes[k]).map(([k,label])=>`<dt>${label}</dt><dd>${esc(notes[k])}</dd>`).join('')}</dl>${['tools','irritants','actors'].flatMap(kind=>st[kind].filter(e=>Object.values(e.notes).some(Boolean)||Object.values(e.ratings).some(Boolean)).map(e=>`<details class="kit"><summary>${esc(entryLabel(kind,e))} · notes${kind==='tools'?' et étoiles':''}</summary>${noteReport(e.notes)}${kind==='tools'?ratingsText(e.ratings):''}</details>`)).join('')}<button class="text-btn" data-action="discussion" data-step="${step.number}">Compléter les échanges de cette étape</button></div>`;
}
function ratingsText(r){return `<p class="small">${RATINGS.map(([k,l])=>esc(l)+' : '+(r[k]?r[k]+'/5':'non évalué')).join(' · ')}</p>`;}
function noteReport(notes){return Object.entries(noteLabels).filter(([k])=>notes?.[k]).map(([k,label])=>`<p><strong>${label}</strong><br>${nl(notes[k])}</p>`).join('');}

      const x=js.steps[String(st.number)];return `<article class="report-stage"><h3>Étape ${st.number}${st.key?' · Moment clé n° '+st.hole:' · Repère'}</h3><p>${esc(st.text)}</p><div class="report-actors">${x.actors.map(e=>`<span>${imageFor('actors',e)}<b>${esc(entryLabel('actors',e))}</b></span>`).join('')}</div>${noteReport(x.discussion)}${['tools','irritants','actors'].flatMap(kind=>x[kind].map(e=>`<section class="report-card ${kind}"><h4>${kind==='tools'?'Outil':kind==='irritants'?'Irritant':'Personnage'} · ${esc(kind==='tools'?displayToolName(e):entryLabel(kind,e))}</h4>${noteReport(e.notes)}${kind==='tools'?ratingsText(e.ratings):''}</section>`)).join('')}</article>`;

h2{margin:0}blockquote{font:24px/1.4 Georgia,serif;border-left:4px solid #f56a50;margin:20px 0;padding:10px 20px;background:#fef4ee}.report-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:15px function fileName(s){return String(s).normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g,'_').slice(0,80)||'groupe';}
function download(name,data,type){const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data],{type}));const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),20000);}
function exportJSON(sessions){const payload=makeBackup(sessions);if(isAdmin)payload.administrator=clone(db.pack);download('Sauvegarde_exco_'+fileName(sessions.length===1?sessions[0].name:'plusieurs_groupes')+'.json',JSON.stringify(payload,null,2),'application/json;charset=utf-8');}
function exportCSV(sessions){download('Choix_exco_'+fileName(sessions.length===1?sessions[0].name:'plusieurs_groupes')+'.csv',toCSV(exportRows(sessions)),'text/csv;charset=utf-8');}

const isAdmin=globalThis.PACK_ROLE==='admin';
let registration=null,adminTab='groups',adminFilter='',pendingImports=[],pendingAdminState=null,importFailures=[];
const globalLabels={messages:'Messages essentiels',consensus:'Consensus transversaux validés en plénière',desaccords:'Non-consensus et désaccords',edl:'Éléments de langage à diffuser',irritants:'Autres irritants relevés sur le terrain',questions:'Questions et points à confirmer',actions:'Actions communes et démarche d’aller-vers',suivi:'Suivi, responsables et échéances'};
function initPack(){
 db.pack=db.pack&&typeof db.pack==='object'?db.pack:{};
 db.pack.workshop=ExcoPack.cleanWorkshop(db.pack.workshop);
 db.pack.global=ExcoPack.cleanGlobal(db.pack.global);
 db.pack.receipts=Array.isArray(db.pack.receipts)?db.pack.receipts.slice(-500):[];
 if(isAdmin){view='admin';$('adminHomeButton').hidden=false;$('participantSendButton').hidden=true;}
 else if(!session().registrationCompleted||(!session().roster.some(p=>p.name.trim())&&!session().participants.trim()))view='registration';
}
function optionList(values,current){return values.map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x)}" ${x===current?'selected':''}>${esc(x||'À préciser')}</option>`).join('');}
function formRow(p,i){return `<tr><td><input aria-label="Nom du participant ${i+1}" data-person="${p.id}" data-key="name" maxlength="100" value="${esc(p.name)}" placeholder="Prénom et nom"></td><td><select aria-label="Structure du participant ${i+1}" data-person="${p.id}" data-key="organisation">${optionList(['',...ExcoPack.organisations],p.organisation)}</select></td><td><input aria-label="Département du participant ${i+1}" data-person="${p.id}" data-key="department" maxlength="80" value="${esc(p.department)}" placeholder="Ex. 94"></td><td><select aria-label="Rôle du participant ${i+1}" data-person="${p.id}" data-key="role">${optionList(['','Saisie','Rapporteur','Gardien du temps','Animateur','Participant'],p.role)}</select></td><td><select aria-label="Aisance numérique du participant ${i+1}" data-person="${p.id}" data-key="level">${optionList(['','Découverte','Intermédiaire','À l’aise'],p.level)}</select></td><td><select aria-label="Expérience CPTS MSP CDS du participant ${i+1}" data-person="${p.id}" data-key="experience">${optionList(['','À découvrir','Occasionnelle','Régulière'],p.experience)}</select></td><td><button class="roster-remove" data-action="remove-person" data-id="${p.id}" aria-label="Retirer le participant ${i+1}">×</button></td></tr>`;}
function beginRegistration(){
 const s=session(),d=s.registrationDraft;
 registration={name:d?.name??s.name,department:d?.department??s.department,animatorEmail:d?.animatorEmail??(isAdmin?db.pack.workshop.animatorEmail:s.workshop.animatorEmail),assignedJourney:d?.assignedJourney||s.assignedJourney||s.currentJourney,roster:clone(d?.roster||s.roster||[])};
 if(!registration.roster.length)registration.roster=['CPAM','ARS','SESAN'].map(organisation=>({id:uid(),name:'',organisation,department:s.department,role:'',level:'',experience:''}));
}

 $('mainContent').innerHTML=`<section class="pack-page"><div class="pack-page-head"><div><p class="eyebrow">Atelier numérique · plateau V9</p><h1>Votre groupe, votre parcours</h1><p>Identifiez votre table et les personnes qui vont échanger ensemble.</p></div><div class="pack-page-actions"><button class="btn secondary" data-action="import-json">Importer un groupe préparé</button>${isAdmin?'<button class="btn secondary" data-action="admin-home">Espace animateur</button>':s.registrationCompleted?'<button class="btn secondary" data-action="board">Retour au jeu</button>':''}</div></div>
 ${db.sessions.length>1?`<div class="pack-group-switch"><label for="entryGroupSelect">Groupe à renseigner</label><select id="entryGroupSelect">${db.sessions.map(g=>`<option value="${g.id}" ${g.id===s.id?'selected':''}>${esc(g.name)}${g.department?' · '+esc(g.department):''}</option>`).join('')}</select><button class="btn secondary small" data-action="pack-new-group">Nouveau groupe</button></div>`:''}
 <section class="entry-section"><h2><span>01</span> La table</h2><div class="entry-meta"><label>Nom du groupe<input id="entryName" data-registration="name" maxlength="180" value="${esc(registration.name)}" placeholder="Ex.  <section class="entry-section"><h2><span>02</span> Le parcours choisi</h2><div class="entry-journeys">${CATALOG.journeys.map(j=>`<button class="entry-journey ${registration.assignedJourney===j.id?'selected':''}" data-action="entry-journey" data-id="${j.id}" aria-pressed="${registration.assignedJourney===j.id}"><img src="${getCard('actors',j.id).image}" alt=""><div><strong>${esc(j.title)}</strong><span>${esc(j.theme)}</span><small>${j.steps.length} étapes · 5 moments clés</small></div><b aria-hidden="true">${registration.assignedJourney===j.id?'✓':'+'}</b></button>`).join('')}</div></section>
 <section class="entry-section"><div class="entry-section-head"><h2><span>03</span> Les participants</h2><button class="btn soft small" data-action="add-person" ${registration.roster.length>=10?'disabled':''}>+ Ajouter une personne</button></div><p class="pack-help">Cible : 5 à 7 personnes. Maximum : 10. Croisez les structures et les expériences. Les rôles peuvent être cumulés.</p><div class="roster-scroll"><table class="roster-table"><thead><tr><th>Participant</th><th>Structure</th><th>Département</th><th>Rôle</th><th>Aisance numérique</th><th>Expérience CPTS / MSP / CDS</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${registration.roster.map(formRow).join('')}</tbody></table></div>${!s.roster?.length&&s.participants?`<p class="pack-help">Participants saisis dans l’ancienne version : ${esc(s.participants)}. Complétez les lignes pour disposer d’une liste structurée.</p>`:''}<div id="entryWarnings" class="entry-warnings"></div></section>
 <div class="entry-finish"><p>Les choix et les échanges seront enregistrés sur cet appareil. Le JSON permettra de les transmettre et de reprendre le travail.</p><div>${isAdmin?'<button class="btn secondary" data-action="save-entry" data-destination="admin">Enregistrer le groupe</button>':''}<button class="btn coral" data-action="save-entry" data-destination="board">Enregistrer et ouvrir le parcours</button></div></div><p id="entryError" class="error-text" role="alert"></p></section>`;
 updateEntryWarnings();
}
function updateEntryWarnings(){const node=$('entryWarnings');if(node)node.innerHTML=ExcoPack.rosterWarnings({...registration,roster:registration.roster.filter(p=>p.name.trim())}).map(t=>'<p>'+esc(t)+'</p>').join('');}
function rememberEntry(){session().registrationDraft=clone(registration);persist();updateEntryWarnings();}
function saveEntry(destination='board'){
 if(!registration.name.trim()){$('entryError').textContent='Donnez un nom au groupe.';$('entryName').focus();return;}
 const people=registration.roster.filter(p=>p.name.trim());
 if(!isAdmin&&!people.length){$('entryError').textContent='Inscrivez au moins une personne. Vous pourrez compléter le groupe ensuite.';return;}
 const email=$('entryEmail').value.trim();if(email&&!/^[^\s@,;]+@[^\s@,;]+\.[^\s@,;]+$/.test(email)){$('entryError').textContent='Vérifiez le courriel de l’animateur.';return;}
 const s=session();s.name=registration.name.trim();s.department=registration.department.trim();s.roster=ExcoPack.cleanRoster(people);s.assignedJourney=registration.assignedJourney;s.currentJourney=registration.assignedJourney;s.participants=s.roster.map(p=>p.name+(p.organisation?' ('+p.organisation+')':'')).join(', ');s.registrationCompleted=true;s.registrationDraft=null;
 s.workshop={...(isAdmin?db.pack.workshop:s.workshop),animatorEmail:email};persist();view=destination==='admin'?'admin':'board';render();window.scrollTo({top:0});toast('Groupe enregistré. Le compteur démarre uniquement quand vous cliquez sur Démarrer.');
}
function toolSheetMarkup(c){
 const parent=c.parent||({chat:'santelien',maillage:'ror'}[c.id])||c.id,kit=CATALOG.kit[parent];
 const children=CATALOG.subcards.filter(x=>x.parent===c.id);
 return `<article class="tool-sheet"><div class="tool-sheet-title">${c.logo||c.image?`<img src="${c.logo||c.image}" alt="${esc(c.name)}">`:''}<div><p class="eyebrow">${c.parent?'Usage précis · '+esc(getCard('tools',c.parent).name):'Fiche outil'}</p><h3>${esc(c.name)}</h3></div></div><p class="tool-definition">${esc(c.description||c.subtitle||'')}</p>${kit?Object.entries(kit).map(([label,text])=>`<section class="tool-sheet-field"><h4>${esc(label)}</h4><p>${nl(text)}</p></section>`).join(''):'<p class="pack-help">Carte libre : le groupe précise le service, son usage et les conditions à vérifier.</p>'}${children.length?`<section class="tool-sheet-field"><h4>Usages précis du jeu</h4>${children.map(x=>`<button class="tool-related" data-action="discover-tool" data-id="${x.id}">${esc(x.name)}</button>`).join('')}</section>`:''}<details class="kit"><summary>Points à confirmer dans l’annexe</summary>${CATALOG.points.filter(x=>{const a=(x||'').toLocaleLowerCase('fr');return a.includes(c.name.toLocaleLowerCase('fr'))||a.includes(getCard('tools',parent)?.name.toLocaleLowerCase('fr')||'xxx');}).map(x=>'<p>'+esc(x)+'</p>').join('')||'<p>Consultez la liste transversale dans les références du kit.</p>'}</details><p class="tool-reference">Annexe de référence fournie par l’organisateur, datée du ${esc(CATALOG.sourceDate)}. Les points « à confirmer » conservent ce statut.</p></article>`;
}

function openEmail(){const email=$('submitEmail').value.trim();if(!/^[^\s@,;]+@[^\s@,;]+\.[^\s@,;]+$/.test(email)){$('submissionMessageStatus').textContent='Renseignez un courriel valide pour l’animateur.';return;}session().workshop.animatorEmail=email;persist();const href='mailto:'+encodeURIComponent(email)+'?subject='+encodeURIComponent('Atelier exco-num · résultats de '+session().name)+'&body='+encodeURIComponent(submissionMessage());const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=href;a.click();$('submissionMessageStatus').textContent='Le message est prêt dans votre messagerie. Ajoutez le JSON et envoyez-le. Si la messagerie ne s’ouvre pas, utilisez « Copier le message ».';}
async function copyMessage(){const message=submissionMessage();try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(message);$('submissionMessageStatus').textContent='Message copié. Collez-le dans votre messagerie et ajoutez le JSON.';}catch(e){const node=$('submissionMessageFallback');node.hidden=false;node.value=message;node.focus();node.select();$('submissionMessageStatus').textContent='Copiez ce texte, puis ajoutez le JSON à votre message.';}}
function adminGroups(){return ExcoPack.visibleGroups(db.sessions);}
function adminSelection(){return adminGroups().filter(s=>!db.pack.excluded?.includes(s.id));}
